verdicts.reason: A gets the reading order wrong: the blue event-details box sits above the headline. The headline is small for the format, its wrap leaves FESTIVAL as a near-orphan, and it lies on a busy door and wall area; the two small boxes float apart with large dead zones around them. B reads correctly (headline at top, then the blue details box, then the black tagline box) and its large headline holds the hierarchy. Its flaws: FURNITURE/DESIGN run over the busy shelving on the right, the faint white strip behind the headline looks accidental, and the left edges of the headline (~22px), blue box (~32px) and black box (~50px) don't line up.
